title: The waiting-page time test cannot expire
why: Found by the c120 lane, Oct 27 10:56 CDT: since 09:45 CDT every CI run is red (gates-shoot on main and every branch; run 40530284999, claude-settings a97af49).
note: Done: lane ci-waiting-page-date merged in batch #697 (main 2ca8925, Oct 27 11:01 CDT); the test's due date is now 2099. Cause: the test "times are 24-hour Chicago time with the zone named" in skills/waiting-page/tests/page.test.mjs sets a due date of 2026-10-27T14:45:00Z and asserts "Answer by Oct 27, 09:45 CDT"; past that time the page shows "Answer was due ... 1 hour ago". Fix: a fixed fake clock in the test (or a due date relative to now), so the assertion keeps its meaning and cannot expire; never skip or weaken it.
